Chapter 510: Chapter 11: Suggesting the Galaxy Master to Come Over (Please Subscribe)

“A World Tree sapling?”

Lin Yuan also found this treasure from the reward list.

Actually, Lin Yuan had been paying attention to the World Tree sapling for a while,

since it was one of the few treasures he recognized.

In the cosmic starry skies of the Main World, the World Tree is a rare treasure that is found only by chance.

Its World Fruits can open up an inner world for an Evolver ahead of time, putting them far ahead of their peers at the same level.

...

As even Lin Yuan, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, only painfully achieved his inner world at the moment he advanced from the Sixth Rank Peak to the Seventh Rank.

And yet, the World Fruit could directly accomplish this feat, which speaks volumes about the value of the World Tree.

“You have integrated dozens of cosmic forces with the Complete Space Rules, establishing a profoundly terrifying foundation, and your inner world also must have a treasure of sufficient weight to preside over it.”

“The World Tree is most suitable.”

The Stone Statue Shen Ji spoke.

There are many uses for the World Tree, including presiding over the inner world and stabilizing all the energetic rules within it, like earth, wind, fire, and water.

A single World Tree is more useful than tens of thousands of cosmic rare treasures.

Even if the World Tree presides over the inner world, it could potentially expand it further, possibly breaking the shackles that limit human evolution to millions of miles in their inner worlds.

“Among the treasures in the first and second layers of the reward treasury, the value of the World Tree sapling ranks in the top three; I even think it’s the first.”

The Stone Statue spoke.

The reason it’s ‘I think’ is because at the level of treasures like the World Tree sapling, it’s hard to clearly distinguish the first from the second; it completely depends on whether it suits the individual.

“Then let’s go with the World Tree sapling,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Even without the Stone Statue Shen Ji’s suggestion, Lin Yuan would most likely have chosen the World Tree sapling anyway.

After all, with what human civilization knows about the World Tree, Lin Yuan was very eager to have one of his own.

“Planting the World Tree sapling in the inner world, generally speaking, the more abundant the essence of the inner world, the faster the World Tree sapling will grow,” the Stone Statue Shen Ji said.

“Understood,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Once the World Tree matures, it will produce World Fruits, a treasure of immense value. Even if Lin Yuan doesn’t use them himself, he could easily sell them.

It’s estimated that even Supreme Beings would be willing to pay a price to purchase World Fruits, to lay a foundation for their offspring.

With the power of the World Fruits, even a Sixth Rank Evolver could open up an inner world, similar to a weakened version of Starry Sky Wanderer Kun.

“As for the third treasure, I currently have no suggestions,” the Stone Statue Shen Ji spoke.

“No suggestions…” Lin Yuan glanced at the reward list again.

Currently, he wasn’t lacking anything and didn’t know which treasure to choose as a reward.

If he chose wrongly, Lin Yuan guessed he would regret it for a long time.

“Master Shen Ji, is it possible to keep the last chance to choose a reward for later use?” Lin Yuan tentatively asked.

Once a treasure from the reward list is chosen, it cannot be exchanged, and Lin Yuan planned to decide later.

“No problem,” the Stone Statue Shen Ji nodded.

If it were during the heyday of the Magic Jade Tower, when practitioners were always entering the Black Tower, it would naturally be better to choose from the reward list as soon as possible.

After all, if you choose too late, you might find that other practitioners have already taken the treasure, but now?

For countless millennia, only Lin Yuan has been such a practitioner, and it’s predictable that, for a long time to come, it will still only be Lin Yuan.

So there is virtually no chance that the treasures from the reward list will be picked before him.

With no one else competing, who would make a selection?

“Do you plan on trying the second layer?” the Stone Statue asked with a smile.

The first layer of the Black Tower is only passable by Eighth Layer beings who have fully comprehended the Complete Space Rules or several other powerful cosmic forces.

And the second layer of the Black Tower? It has nothing to do with Eighth Layer beings but only the very strongest among the Ninth Rank could hope to pass through the second layer of the Black Tower.

Even Lin Yuan, who has mastered dozens of cosmic forces, including the Source-level Cosmic Force, stands no chance of passing through the second layer of the Black Tower.

The essence of his life is such that, although the Source-level Cosmic Force offers unlimited potential, he would need to continue growing. Currently, as an Eighth-Layer being, even with the Source-level Cosmic Force, he definitely could not pass through the second layer of the Black Tower.

The Stone Statue’s inquiry about whether Lin Yuan intended to try passing the second layer was simply out of boredom, hoping Lin Yuan might stay in this training space a while longer.

“Hmm,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Following the black stairs, he arrived at the second layer of the Black Tower.

Seeing this, the Stone Statue disappeared into the distance and reappeared outside the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

Rustling.

A series of images appeared before the Stone Statue, showing every detail of the second layer of the Black Tower.

“The pressure has increased a lot…”

Upon arriving at the second layer of the Black Tower, Lin Yuan immediately felt a terrifying pressure coming from all directions.

Varieties of cosmic forces operated around him, and even the Source-level Cosmic Force, the Primal Force, circulated around him as Lin Yuan walked with difficulty toward the central black stairway of the second layer.

Time elapsed.

Lin Yuan had quickly covered a third of the distance.

But the next moment,

dozens of cosmic forces all shattered, and along with them, the Primal Force also dissipated into nothing.

With the loss of the numerous cosmic forces’ protection, Lin Yuan’s form also dissipated into nothingness.

“Failed?”

Outside the Nine Floors Dark Tower, the Stone Statue Shen Ji showed no sign of surprise.

Actually, the fact that Lin Yuan had managed to cover a third of the distance on the second layer of the Black Tower was already incredibly unbelievable.

You should know, this layer is completely intended for Ninth Rank beings, and Lin Yuan managing a third already surpassed many Ninth Rank beings.
